newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Vranitzky claims breakthrough on Albania poll.
newsitem.headline: Vranitzky claims breakthrough on Albania poll.

text.p: European envoy Franz Vranitzky claimed a breakthrough on Friday in plans to hold early elections in Albania, saying the 10 main parties had signed a political contract to ensure the vote went ahead.
"This is a breakthrough which we have achieved today," Vranitzky told a news conference announcing the six-point contract.
"However I hasten to add that bringing it to reality is of course still a very important task by Albanian politicians, by the international community," he said.
Albanian President Sali Berisha hailed the contract as a real and important contribution.
"President Berisha expresses his determination to be committed and to contribute in the implementation of this agreement," a statement from his office said.

Vranitzky was on his fourth visit since widespread rioting over failed pyramid savings schemes broke out in February. A former Austrian chancellor, he is now acting as envoy of the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe.
